missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Батальон' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Наш' agrees in masculine, and 'у реки' takes the genitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Батальон' is the accusative object of 'построил'. As an inanimate masculine noun its accusative matches the nominative. 'Весь' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Батальона' takes the genitive after 'нет', expressing that none is present. 'Целого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Батальоне' is the prepositional after 'об', naming the topic. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Батальону' is the dative after 'к', the recipient of the order. 'Нашему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Батальоном' is the instrumental governed by 'командует', naming what he commands. 'Большим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after number. After 'два' the noun 'батальона' takes the genitive singular form. 'На запад' marks the direction of motion.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Батальоны' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'маршируют'. 'Целые' agrees in plural, and 'на параде' locates them.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Батальона' takes the genitive after 'без', meaning without the battalion. 'Позиция' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Батальон' is the nominative subject. 'Этот' points to a specific unit, and 'опытный' is the agreeing masculine predicate adjective.
